description: Isolated arithmetic comparison; exact equality checked before timing. Lazy smash candidate rejected and retained only under cfg(test). Grouped mul_top retained.
micro_method: Nine alternating-order paired batches; medians of per-operation microseconds. 100 iterations for mul_top; 1000 for val_mul.
suite_caveat: Concurrent host work caused large variation even in unchanged KL controls. End-to-end differences are not reliable causal speedup estimates. Paired in-process microbenchmarks are the acceptance evidence.
